162K likes, 292 comments - hummingbird_homemade_ on November 24, 2025: "Grab 2 plates and meet me in 10 💕

Recipe! ⬇️
•6oz Ditalini pasta
•1 1/2 cups tomato sauce 
•1/3 cup heavy cream
•3 tbsp grated pecorino cheese
•1/3 cup shredder mozzarella 

Meatballs
•1 lb ground beef
•1/4 lb ground Italian sausage
•1/3 cup breadcrumbs
•3 tbsp milk
•1/4 cup grated pecorino cheese
•1 large egg
•2 tbsp chopped parsley 
•1 tsp each dried basil, garlic powder, onion powder, red pepper flakes
•1/2 tsp dried oregano 
•salt & pepper
•2 tbsp olive oil for frying
(Note: The meatball recipe makes a lot more than you need for this pasta dish. Use what you need of the meatball mixture and freeze the rest! I used about 1/4 of this mixture to serve 2 people)

How to:
Combine the meatball ingredients together in a large bowl. Roll out the meatballs and brown them in a skillet with the olive oil. Remove the meatballs from the pan and set to the side. 

Cook the ditalini to 90% doneness, in a pot of salted, boiling water.

Carefully wipe out any remaining olive oil from the pan you used to cook the meatballs. Pour in the tomato sauce and the heavy cream. I used a simple tomato sauce I made with garlic and basil, your favorite homemade or store bought sauce works perfect in this recipe. 

Add the meatballs and the cooked ditalini to the pan with sauce and sprinkle in both of the cheeses. Mix everything together and taste for seasoning.

Serve immediately and top with a sprinkle of pecorino cheese. Enjoy! 💕🍝

#cookwithme #cookinginspo #cookinginspiration #ditalini #pastarecipe #meatballrecipe #dinnerrecipes #cozycooking #cozykitchen #castironcooking #lecreuset".

audio.transcript:
This is a recipe for a delicious and easy to make chicken and vegetable stir fry.

First, you will need to prepare your ingredients. Chop one pound of boneless, skinless chicken breasts into bite-sized pieces. Then, chop one medium onion, two bell peppers of different colors, and one cup of broccoli florets. Mince two cloves of garlic and one inch of fresh ginger.

Next, in a small bowl, whisk together the sauce ingredients: 1/4 cup soy sauce, 2 tablespoons honey, 1 tablespoon rice vinegar, 1 teaspoon sesame oil, and 1 teaspoon cornstarch. Set aside.

Now, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and stir-fry until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.

Add another tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet. Add the chopped onion, bell peppers, and broccoli. Stir-fry for 3-5 minutes until the vegetables are tender-crisp. Add the minced garlic and ginger and stir-fry for another minute until fragrant.

Return the cooked chicken to the skillet. Pour the prepared sauce over the chicken and vegetables. Stir well to coat everything. Cook for 1-2 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.

Serve the chicken and vegetable stir fry immediately over cooked rice or noodles. Enjoy!
